verdict.rationale: Khoj's own setup docs offer Docker or Pip installation and reference a standard docker-compose.yml, so the Docker Compose path is covered, and the docs say it can self-host on consumer hardware. Nothing in the pack shows Kubernetes/Helm, VPS or Raspberry Pi guides. One older community report of a failing docker build (pyside6 dependency) casts some doubt on how well the Docker path is maintained. missing for 10: Kubernetes/Helm guide, dedicated VPS deployment guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, evidence the guides are separately maintained, independent confirmation that the Docker Compose install works
